reason: Confirmed from the cited source and three independent sources I opened. (1) The cited docs.json on master gives ar-modes default "webxr scene-viewer quick-look" and states: "Including quick-look here without an ios-src (our default) will generate a USDZ on the fly rather than downloading a separate ios-src file." The ios-src entry adds that when ios-src is absent the USDZ is generated automatically when the AR button is pressed, but that generated models do not support animations. (2) The same docs.json at the v4.4.0 tag (raw.githubusercontent.com/google/model-viewer/v4.4.0/...) carries the identical default and USDZ sentence, so the claim holds for 4.4.0 specifically, not just master. (3) The source code packages/model-viewer/src/features/ar.ts contains `const DEFAULT_AR_MODES = 'webxr scene-viewer quick-look';`, `const generateUsdz = !this.iosSrc;` and `prepareUSDZ()` using three.js USDZExporter, confirming runtime generation from the loaded glTF. (4) The npm registry lists 4.4.0 as dist-tags.latest, published 2026-10-09T20:10:31Z, and the GitHub v4.4.0 release notes add "Enabled Quick Look AR in third-party iOS browsers without requiring ios-src". model-viewer is a web component, so no native code is involved. Minor precision gaps, not errors: the generated USDZ drops animations (so one GLB covers all three modes only for static or animation-optional models), and Quick Look still requires iOS 12+. Web search budget was exhausted, so no additional third-party commentary was consulted beyond the project's own code, docs, npm, and release pages.
corrected_claim: @google/model-viewer 4.4.0 (npm latest, published 2026-10-09) defaults ar-modes to "webxr scene-viewer quick-look" and, when ios-src is absent, generates the USDZ on the fly in the browser via three.js USDZExporter when the AR button is pressed, so a single GLB serves Android WebXR, Scene Viewer, and iOS Quick Look (iOS 12+, and as of 4.4.0 also third-party iOS browsers) with no native code; the auto-generated USDZ does not carry animations, so animated models may need a supplied ios-src. Sources: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/google/model-viewer/v4.4.0/packages/modelviewer.dev/data/docs.json ; https://raw.githubusercontent.com/google/model-viewer/master/packages/model-viewer/src/features/ar.ts ; https://github.com/google/model-viewer/releases/tag/v4.4.0
